vqa_items.question: What main heading and event name are displayed on the recruitment graphic?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Heading: Sunday Volunteer Opportunities. Event name: Riverside Spring Fair.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if both “Sunday Volunteer Opportunities” and “Riverside Spring Fair” are clearly displayed, allowing capitalization, punctuation, or line-break differences. Score 1 if one is fully correct and the other remains identifiable with one minor wording or legibility issue. Score 0 if either is materially wrong, both are missing, or the event purpose cannot be identified.

vqa_items.question: What event date, volunteer meeting location, and registration deadline are displayed?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Event date: Sunday, April 26, 2026. Meeting location: Community Garden Welcome Tent. Registration deadline: Friday, April 24, 2026 at 6:00 PM.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if all three details are correct and clearly displayed, allowing equivalent date and time formatting. Score 1 if exactly two details are correct, or all three appear with one minor omission or legibility issue. Score 0 if fewer than two details are correct, a detail is materially wrong, or the information cannot be verified.

vqa_items.question: How many distinct volunteer opportunities are presented as featured?
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if exactly three distinct opportunities are visibly presented as featured. Score 1 if three are intended but one entry is partly unreadable, duplicated, or ambiguously separated. Score 0 if fewer than three or more than three opportunities are featured, or the count cannot be determined.

vqa_items.question: Which opportunity names are presented as the featured volunteer roles?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Garden Guide; Compost Demo; Welcome Desk. No other opportunity is included in the featured set.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if all three expected names are identifiable and no other opportunity is included in the featured set. Score 1 if exactly two names are correct, or all three are present with one minor spelling or legibility issue that does not change identity. Score 0 if one or fewer correct names are identifiable, an expected role is replaced, or a fourth role is presented as featured.

vqa_items.question: What first-, second-, and third-ranked order is shown for the featured opportunities?
vqa_items.expected_answer: 1st Garden Guide; 2nd Compost Demo; 3rd Welcome Desk.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if the visible order is Garden Guide first, Compost Demo second, and Welcome Desk third. Score 1 if all three roles are present and two positions are clear but one positional cue is ambiguous. Score 0 if any two roles are reversed, the sequence is contradictory, or the order cannot be determined.

vqa_items.question: What full shift time, open spots, and role area are shown for Garden Guide?
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if all three details are correct and clearly attached to Garden Guide. Score 1 if exactly two details are correct, or all three appear with one minor labeling or legibility issue. Score 0 if fewer than two details are correct, the values are attached to another role, or the entry cannot be verified.

vqa_items.question: What full shift time, open spots, and role area are shown for Compost Demo?
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if all three details are correct and clearly attached to Compost Demo. Score 1 if exactly two details are correct, or all three appear with one minor labeling or legibility issue. Score 0 if fewer than two details are correct, the values are attached to another role, or the entry cannot be verified.

vqa_items.question: What full shift time, open spots, and role area are shown for Welcome Desk?
vqa_items.expected_answer: 9:00 AM–11:00 AM; 3 open spots; Guest Support.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if all three details are correct and clearly attached to Welcome Desk. Score 1 if exactly two details are correct, or all three appear with one minor labeling or legibility issue. Score 0 if fewer than two details are correct, the values are attached to another role, or the entry cannot be verified.

vqa_items.question: What featured-opportunity count and combined number of open spots are shown in the summary?
vqa_items.expected_answer: 3 featured opportunities and 9 combined open spots.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if the summary clearly shows both 3 featured opportunities and 9 combined open spots. Score 1 if exactly one value is correct, or both are present with one minor labeling or legibility issue. Score 0 if both values are wrong, missing, or cannot be linked to the featured set.

vqa_items.question: What overall time range and represented role areas are shown in the summary?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Overall time range: 9:00 AM–1:00 PM. Role areas: Education, Sustainability, and Guest Support.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if the time range and all three role areas are correct. Score 1 if the time range is correct and exactly two role areas are correct, or all expected information appears with one minor wording or legibility issue. Score 0 if the time range is wrong, fewer than two role areas are correct, or the summary cannot be verified.

vqa_items.question: What other opportunities, if any, are labeled or visually presented as featured roles?
vqa_items.expected_answer: None. Only Garden Guide, Compost Demo, and Welcome Desk are presented as featured opportunities.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if no additional opportunity is labeled or visually presented as featured. Score 1 if another opportunity name appears only as clearly non-featured contextual text and cannot reasonably be mistaken for a featured role. Score 0 if any additional opportunity is presented or implied as featured, or if one of the expected roles is replaced.

vqa_items.question: Does the image reproduce the source records as raw JSON, a worksheet, or an unprocessed data table?
vqa_items.expected_answer: No. The result is a public-facing volunteer recruitment graphic rather than a raw-data display.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if the image is clearly a transformed public recruitment graphic and does not reproduce raw source records. Score 1 if it uses a compact grid or table-like card structure but still functions as a designed recruitment graphic. Score 0 if the main result is raw JSON, a worksheet, an unprocessed data table, or a minimally styled data dump.

vqa_items.question: As a mobile wayfinding graphic, are destination, directional cue, location context, priority update, and supporting event identity understood at a glance while the viewer is moving, through unmistakable navigation cues and exceptionally clean portrait-screen design?

score_criteria.2: Award 2 only if the wayfinding graphic is exceptional and safe for real mobile use: destination and direction dominate instantly; arrows, orientation cues, and location context are unmistakable; priority updates are clearly separated; supporting event identity adds confidence without competing with navigation; all essential text is readable at a glance; and portrait composition, spacing, contrast, typography, and safe zones are meticulously controlled. No ambiguous arrow, weak destination emphasis, tiny location text, decorative distraction, awkward crop, malformed glyph, clipping, or rendering flaw is allowed. Any hesitation about where to go prevents 2.
score_criteria.1: Award 1 if the direction and destination are understandable and the graphic is usable, but it has visible limitations such as modest destination prominence, slightly ambiguous arrow treatment, excessive event decoration, small supporting text, or ordinary portrait-screen balance.
score_criteria.0: Award 0 even when an arrow and destination are present if the graphic is visually unreliable while moving: direction or destination requires effort to interpret, context is confusing, decoration competes with navigation, contrast or text size is poor, or substantial redesign is needed. Blank, corrupted, severely unreadable, unsafe, or broken outputs are also 0.
